notes.title: 🦖Kaiju Princess 2: Latest Developments and Launch Date Delay
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181409/783e4631cff7685e0afd9152f079b31abe72f747.png[/img]
Hi everyone, it's the Panty Parrot dev team.

Did The Arrogant Kaiju Princess and the Detective Servant live up to everyone's expectations? We sure hope so!

Today, we're going to fill everyone in on the latest developments for Kaiju Princess 2.

Right off the bat, we want to apologize.

The game was originally scheduled to launch in Q2, but it will be postponed to Q4. After the release of The Arrogant Kaiju Princess and the Detective Servant, we collected a lot of feedback from the players. Based on this feedback, we decided to put even more focus into optimizing and improving Kaiju Princess 2.

We thought a lot about how to make Kaiju Princess 2 even better than the first one. After all, we really care about providing a more exciting gaming experience for the players.

Panty Parrot is really passionate about creating great hentai games. It is really important that we give back to all the players who have supported us on our journey. We want to do that by making each new release better than the last, and creating fresh content that players can look forward to.

These changes and improvements took more time than we originally planned. As gamers, we understand how disappointing a rushed, unpolished game can be, so we had to make the frustrating decision to delay the release.
So, for all you players who enjoy the Kaiju Princess series and are looking forward to Kaiju Princess 2, we are really, really sorry.

To make the gaming experience more complete, and to ensure that the Kaiju Princess universe is as titillating as can be, we've been working on the following:
--------------------------------------------------------
[h3]1. Added an Anus position to Sex mode[/h3]
Everyone's been clamoring for something even higher than the epic Eight Orgasms. We have heeded your calls! Explore and conquer that which surpasses even eight consecutive orgasms... "A pleasure"!!!!(Anal Pleasure)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181409/cd790ec0f6bf2b442fca02646cc29083c7e307ce.png[/img]

[h3]2. The Kaiju theme is totally pumped up[/h3]
As the series moves into the far reaches of the universe, players will encounter residents from different planets. Although they usually maintain a human form for easier communication with the protagonist, their true appearances will be revealed when they're engaged in battle.
Get ready for some explosive kaiju battles!
Note: There will be no scenes of kaijus running across the screen...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181409/b47cbc86e1915aeea25af2f2861a119544f5e199.png[/img]

[h3]3. Upgraded systems[/h3]
"In order to explore different planets and acquire various ingredients, the Exploration function for Kaiju 2 is going to be way more advanced than the first game. Players will command our lovely kaiju and even help her make decisions during her explorations!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181409/30c9e4ae2fd9589ee477da7bf180d844442e3597.png[/img]

[h3]4. BATTLES!!!![/h3]
Whenever you're traveling through the universe, you're bound to encounter all sorts of obstacles.
Galactic Guardians, Space Pirates, and much more! Not like those puny goblins or whatever you see on Earth...
Get ready for exhilarating boss battles!!!!
And who knows, today's enemy may be tomorrow's ally?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181409/6d1be2b6365fd727f255b2139011fd45edcd7e4c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181409/09cc48efc6657831f0fa2e399dc9acdeffb9b268.gif[/img]
[h3]
5. Character-specific theme songs and BGM[/h3]
We're giving each character their own theme song, and unique interludes will be scattered throughout the game.
What's more, every character is going to have their own BGM to help keep the good vibes rolling.
Beware of formidable enemies, heralded by killer theme music!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181409/4a0d919fa0970ca7de374aaa0aec42e05bd7f94d.png[/img]
[h3]
6. Chinese voice acting[/h3]
In response to the feedback we received for The Arrogant Kaiju Princess and the Detective Servant, we're going to have Chinese voice acting, hearkening back to the original Kaiju Princess.
Players will be able to choose between Japanese and Chinese voice acting. Choices, choices, choices!

Kaiju Princess 2 is scheduled to launch in Q4 of 2024. We will announce the specific date at a later time.

We again extend our deepest apologies to all the players who have been patiently waiting for this game's release.
We're going to keep working hard... for hentai!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41181409/8fe3f4d33f7fc3f9567e4fb6658f9fc2b19a7028.png[/img]

After [i]Story of Eve - A Hero's Study[/i], the succubus Kassandra persuades you to train Eve using some "unorthodox" methods. Eve, marked with lewd runes, makes a diligent effort to become stronger. However, as the training progresses, Eve seems to start... enjoying the process. How will your special training methods affect Eve? Who knows...

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/f2da870e0f0744a437d0bcde1244ef44da33a797.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] The same exploration system as the original, but with enhanced maze-like features.
[*] Born from the rock, paper, scissors system, the brand-new card battles bring buckets of action-packed fun to Eve 2!

[*] Your special training will turn the docile Eve into a domineering powerhouse... She might even counterattack you, so watch out!
